set.body: SemanticGraph (unforgeable; no chart, spans, sentence, provenance, ConceptId), SemanticHandle, canonical projection with gloss-aware keying and typed refusal on budget exhaustion (no id-order fallback); compat.scala refactored to one generic core used by ChartCompatibility.compare (signature and output unchanged) and SemanticCompatibility. Fixes compare's ConceptId tie-break/greedy relation order dependence for the strict path. Acceptance: S2a-0 pins green; rename/permutation laws on SemanticCompatibility; court + mutants.
